summary: The analysis is thorough, well-structured, and demonstrates strong understanding of the problem space and codebase. It correctly identifies three enforcement gaps (local modification bypass, branch switching, late enforcement token waste) and proposes a layered solution (Layer 0-4) that addresses each gap at the appropriate enforcement point. The research covers the relevant gateway, session, container spawner, and worktree management code. Minor line-number inaccuracies exist in codebase references but the architectural understanding is sound. One factual inaccuracy (EGG_PHASE claimed as already set on the session environment, when it's only stored on the Session dataclass but not passed as a container env var) does not materially affect the proposal since the analysis correctly identifies that the phase is available in the gateway context. The lack of competing alternative approaches is acceptable given the issue author provided a prescriptive solution direction.
